record.question: Pakistan's nuclear capable ballistic missile series known as Shaheen is named after:
record.explanation: Answer C: Falcon species. Pakistan’s Shaheen missile series is named after the Shaheen falcon (peregrine falcon), not a mountain goat, owl, or deer. Reference: https://www.nti.org/analysis/articles/pakistan-missile-overview/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
